definitions.explanation: the phase of the moon when it appears as a complete circle, fully illuminated by the sun

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{満月|まんげつ}だ。
{満月|まんげつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{月見|つきみ}→月見：13001_tsukimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We did moon viewing on the night of the full moon.

examples.japanese: {満月|まんげつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あか}るく→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦{照|て}らしている→照らす：04669_terasu⟧。
examples.english: The full moon is brightly illuminating the sea.

notes:
JAPANESE CULTURE:
お⟦{月見|つきみ}→月見：13001_tsukimi⟧ (moon viewing) is a traditional Japanese autumn custom, especially during the ⟦{十五夜|じゅうごや}→十五夜：24745_juugoya⟧ (fifteenth night of the eighth lunar month). People view the full moon and offer ⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧ (rice dumplings) and {薄|すすき} (Japanese pampas grass).

MOON PHASES:
- ⟦{新月|しんげつ}→新月：17599_shingetsu⟧ (new moon)
- ⟦{三日月|みかづき}→三日月：17597_mikazuki⟧ (crescent moon)
- ⟦{半月|はんげつ}→半月：08507_hangetsu⟧ (half moon)
- {満月|まんげつ} (full moon)

FORMS:
{満|まん} (full) + {月|げつ} (moon) → full moon
